# Migration Reporting Skill

## Use This Skill When
- Pipeline artifacts need stakeholder-facing summaries and evidence logs.

## Rules
- Generate four reports: plan, risk, execution, validation.
- Include traceability fields: plan_hash, rule_ids_used, reviewer, timestamps.
- Highlight UNMAPPED and manual-handling dependencies explicitly.
- Keep reports secret-safe and evidence-backed.

See report-templates.md for table formats.
